item.description: AI summary: The Financial Services Agency announced draft amendments to its notice on economic value-based solvency regulation on 2026-11-10. The proposal would align item names in the Pillar 3 notice with those in financial results reporting tables and clarify input items for economic value-based amounts concerning insurers' claims-paying capacity. item.title: Public consultation on Keisei Electric Railway's proposed passenger fare caps
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism announced a public consultation on 2026-11-09 concerning Keisei Electric Railway Co., Ltd.'s application, dated 2026-11-06, to change passenger fare caps. The proposed average fare increases are 14.3% for ordinary fares and 13.7% for season tickets, comprising a 16.9% increase for commuter tickets and an 11.5% decrease for student tickets; the overall increase is 14.1%. These comparisons include the existing station accessibility surcharge, which the proposal would abolish alongside the fare revision. Under Article 16(1) of the Railway Business Act (Act No. 92 of 1986), fare-cap changes require ministerial approval; the announcement describes planned referral to the Transport Council, not an approval already granted. The stated consultation period was 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-23, with comments required to arrive by the latter date. item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-09, the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries announced the selection of the Uku-Ojika area in Nagasaki Prefecture as a new Digital Fisheries Strategy Hub in the second selection round for fiscal 2026. item.title: Draft hazardous-materials ordinance and notices: tank inspections, sprinklers and firefighting foam
item.description: AI summary: The Fire and Disaster Management Agency, Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, published a consultation on 2026-11-07 on a draft Ministerial Ordinance and two draft amending Notices; the stated comment deadline is 2026-12-07 23:59 JST. The drafts would amend the Regulations on the Control of Hazardous Materials (Prime Minister's Office Ordinance No. 55 of 1959), the Notice prescribing detailed technical standards for hazardous-materials control (Ministry of Home Affairs Notice No. 99 of 1974), and the Notice prescribing detailed technical standards for foam extinguishing equipment at manufacturing facilities and other facilities (Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications Notice No. 559 of 2011). They would permit alternating current field measurement testing for bottom welds in specified outdoor storage tanks and closed sprinkler heads meeting specified criteria in indoor lithium-ion battery storage facilities. For packaged fixed foam extinguishing equipment at self-service fueling stations, they would allow agents of any type with verified specified extinguishing performance, rather than limiting them to aqueous film-forming or mechanical foam agents. The proposed commencement is the day after promulgation; no promulgation date is stated.
